excerpt.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
excerpt.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

label.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
label.en: Why not let them join us?

label.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
label.en: Why not let them join us?

texts.zh: 在完成[From.GetName]的环境改造之后，我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]注意到了一个黄金的机遇。剩下的环境改造设备经过调整改造后可以作为这个行星的基础设施。
texts.en: After completing the terraforming of [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] have spotted a golden opportunity. The remaining terraforming equipment can potentially be repurposed as infrastructure for the planet.

label.zh: 我们可以用得上更多的住房。
拓展这个星球的能量生产力。

label.en: You can never have enough mines.

label.zh: 把这些设备拆解了就好。

texts.zh: 环境改造[From.GetName]完工得比原先估计的要快，这给了我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一些额外的时间开展一些实验，实验结果十分引人注目。这颗行星的自然特质得到了强化，既有美学情操，又保证了实用主义。
texts.en: Terraforming on [From.GetName] has finished faster than initially estimated, which has left our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] with time to experiment, and the results are impressive. The planet's natural traits have been enhanced to be both aesthetically pleasing and utilitarian.

label.zh: 它非得看上去这么人工吗？
label.en: Does it have to look so artificial?

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上的漫长项目令人沮丧地结束了，只取得了一部分成功。在对最后的几处山谷进行地形变动时，生物质重调器发生了功能异常，导致我们创造出了一大滩环境改造残余物。尽管对于殖民者不构成危险，它还是意味着这个星球目前会有一点狭窄。
texts.en: Our long project on [From.GetName] has frustratingly ended in partial success. As the final valleys were undergoing terramorphing, a malfunction occurred in the biomass realigner, leading to the creation of large swaths of Terraforming Residue. While not dangerous to our colonists, it means that the planet is a bit more cramped for the time being.

texts.zh:
我们为了唤醒[From.GetName]而进行的漫长项目，结果不如预期般顺利。我们的一处生物质重组器发生破裂，释放了少量环境改造残留物，堵塞了山谷并在某些可居住区域形成一层粘性外壳。

虽然这对我们本身没有危险，但这种过多的脓状物质意味着我们一些更具移动性的单位可能会在一段时间内遇到困难。
texts.en:
Our lengthy project to awaken [From.GetName] has not resolved as successfully as we had hoped. A rupture in one of our biomass realigners has released a minor deluge of Terraforming Residue, clogging valleys and forming a sticky crust over certain habitable zones.

While not inherently dangerous to us, this excess of pus-like material means some of our more motile elements may struggle for a time.

texts.zh: 我们不仅成功地对[From.GetName]进行了环境改造，我们还做得更加好了。在定稿阶段的最后，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]设法想让这个星球成为我们本土动物群的完美家园，创造一个同[Root.GetHomeWorldName]及其相似的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。我们的所有本土植物也会移植到那里去，只是地形会不太一样。
texts.en: We have not only succeeded in terraforming [From.GetName], but we have done something even better. During the final stretch of the process, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to make it a perfect home for our local fauna, creating a [From.GetPlanetMoon] eerily similar to [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. All our local plant life is there but none of the familiar terrain.

label.zh: 这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]应该作为[Root.GetHomeWorldName]二号被人所知
label.en: This [From.GetPlanetMoon] shall be known as [Root.GetHomeWorldName] II

texts.zh: 正当[From.GetName]的环境改造工程即将收尾之时，一个独特的情况发生了。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现，我们有可能将这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]变为潮汐锁定。这样的现象如果自然发生了，可能会对殖民地造成危害。然而，如果是在环境改造的过程中这么做，我们就能充分利用昼半球无穷无尽的太阳时长，产出极其丰富的能量。我们当然也要制定一个集中计划，将我们剩余的工业园区和住房布置在夜半球或晨昏线地区。
texts.en: A unique situation has occurred on [From.GetName] just as the terraforming efforts are winding down. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have discovered that it's possible to tidally lock the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. This occurring naturally can be quite a detriment to a colony. However, doing it during the terraforming process could allow us to exploit the endless solar hours the dayside will receive and generate an obscene amount of energy. We would still have to make a concentrated effort to set up the rest of our industry and housing on the twilight and night side.

label.zh: 让[From.GetPlanetMoon]再次转起来，这么做风险太大了。
label.en: Set the [From.GetPlanetMoon] spinning again, the risk is too great.

texts.zh: 随着[From.GetName]环境改造完工，我们发现这一工程使我们处在了一个始料未及的情况。我们实际上需要的资源，并没有我们最初立项的时候预计完成项目所需要的那么多，现在我们有机会为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]增添一项额外的特征。我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]呈递给了我们三个不同的选项。
texts.en: As the terraforming of [From.GetName] is settling down, we discover that the project has put us in an unanticipated situation. We did not need as many resources as we initially set aside to finish this project, and now we have the chance to add-on one additional feature to the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have presented us with three different options.

label.zh: 我们可以使用更多的发电区划。
label.en: We could use more Generator Districts.

label.zh: 看看我们是不是能够为采矿区划提供更多空间。
label.en: See if we can't develop more space for Mining Districts.

label.zh: 这个星球用得上更多的农业区划。
label.en: This world could use more Agriculture Districts.

texts.zh: 在将[From.GetName]转变为[This.GetAAnPlanetClass][This.GetClassAdj]星球的过程中，[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]筹划着不仅将当地动物群连接到主脑，还想将这个星球本身也连接到主脑，尽管有点担心暴露在环境改造气体中有可能诱发突变。蜂群现在有机会在更加真实的感知下，变得前所未有地完整。
texts.en: While turning [From.GetName] into [This.GetAAnPlanetClass] [This.GetClassAdj] world, the [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] managed to link not only the local fauna to the mind but, through freak mutations when exposed to the terraforming gasses, link the mind to the world itself. The collective now has the opportunity to become whole in a truer sense than before.

label.zh: 不，这不是这个星球的意图。
label.en: No, this is not the intention for this world.

texts.zh: 对于蜂群来说，超越自然不是什么新鲜事。在对[From.GetName]进行地形改造的过程中，每一座山峦都经过了考量，每一片动物群的放置都经过了战略推演。这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]现在变成了一处组织完美的后勤天堂，方便我们的[Root.GetUnitDronePlural]为蜂群整体的建设添砖加瓦。
texts.en: Surpassing nature is not something new for this collective. During the terraforming process of [From.GetName], every hill was considered, and every piece of fauna was strategically placed. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] has now ended up being a perfectly organized logistical paradise for our [Root.GetUnitDronePlural] to produce for the collective.

texts.zh:
在为[From.GetName]土地施肥和导入大气的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]有个意外的发现。在[From.GetName]的地表以下存在一个地下外星文明。应该是由于[From.GetPlanetMoon]的矿物密度导致此前我们的扫描仪并未发现他们。
这些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎完全没有意识到行星的地表已经改变，这让我们有了决定如何与他们接触的主动权。
texts.en:
While enriching the soil and adding an atmosphere to [From.GetName], our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have made an unexpected find. Beneath the surface of [From.GetName], there exists a civilization of subterranean aliens. It must have been because of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s mineral density that our scanners didn't detect them before.
The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem unaware that their surface has changed, giving us a chance to do what we will with them.

label.zh: 就是说地底下有害虫咯。
label.en: So the pests scurry underground now.

label.zh: 看到宇宙并不缺乏智慧生物还挺好的。
label.en: It's good to see that the universe is not devoid of intelligent life.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]一开始以为某块地只是[From.GetName]上的一个臭气袋子，结果没想到那里竟是一块福地！它喷发出来的有毒气体实际上是未经精炼的异星天然气。有了这处全新的自然资源，为这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]引入大气层所需的能源巨幅下降了，我们还可以在接下来的很多年采集这里的天然气！
texts.en: What our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] first took for a nasty gas pocket on [From.GetName] has turned out to be a blessing! The toxic fumes it was releasing are an unrefined version of Exotic Gas. With this new natural resource, the energy required to introduce an atmosphere to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] has drastically decreased, and we can harvest the gas for years to come!

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]就[From.GetName]上的情况即带来了好消息，也带来了坏消息。好消息是环境改造进程十分的顺利，我们有了一处美轮美奂的盖亚星球。坏消息是，所有住在这个[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的人都暴露在了环境改造气体中，已经不能适应非盖亚星球的环境了。这些“囿于盖亚”的居民在盖亚星球上生活时，展现出了惊人的生产力提升。相比于没有受到环境改造气体影响、在改造之后才过去的移民，这些居民的表现要好得不知道到哪里去了。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] have good news and bad news for us about [From.GetName]. The good news is that the terraforming process went swimmingly, and we have a beautiful Gaia World. The bad news is that everyone living on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was exposed to the terraforming gasses and now can't live on non-Gaia Worlds. These Gaia-trapped inhabitants have surprisingly been showing an increase in their productivity while on the Gaia World. Far better than workers that weren't affected by the gas that migrated there later.

label.zh: 至少他们看上去没有感到不舒服。
label.en: At least they don't seem to be uncomfortable.

texts.zh: 在我们派往[From.GetName]的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]之中，似乎有部分人是某个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上古老宗派的追随者。这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]相信寰宇之中有一处留给我们人民的天堂，结果他们选择不去寻找，而是亲自去创造这处天堂。[From.GetName]现在被转变成了一处被赐福的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，宛如从我们古老历史的宗卷中显现出来的图景。
texts.en: Amongst our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] assigned to [From.GetName], there seem to have been followers of an ancient sect from [Root.GetHomeWorldName] among them. These [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] believe that there is a paradise for our people, and instead of looking for it, they have now created it. [From.GetName] has now been turned into a [From.GetPlanetMoon] of the blessed, looking like an illustration manifested from the pages of our ancient history.

texts.zh: 我们的环境改造工作者完成了前所未有的功绩！阅尽整个[Root.GetName]的历史，总有一桩神话或传说流传下来，讲述许诺给我们人民的赐福之地——一处天堂。当我们驶向繁星却无处寻觅这处福地时，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]启动了一项计划，要亲自将这个传说化为现实。现在，[From.GetName]的地平线在我们面前向远方延伸，人人肃然起敬，心知我们亲手缔造了属于自己的天堂。
texts.en: Our terraformers have outdone any of their previous work! Throughout [Root.GetName], history there have always been myths and legends about a blessed land for our people, a paradise. When we set out to the stars and didn't find the Land of Bliss, a project to make it a reality was started by our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural]. Now the awe-inspiring horizons of [From.GetName] stretch before us, and we know that we have made our own paradise.

label.zh: 它只是个普通的盖亚星球吧？
label.en: It's just a normal Gaia World?

texts.zh: 在清除[From.GetName]大气层和土壤中的辐射的过程中，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不求助于我们的异星生物学家。他们发现了一个物种，依靠辐射繁衍生息，而现在正在枯萎。更令人惊奇的是，这个物种看上去还处于未开智状态，但将将就要进化出智能了。现在，随着最后一处泥土即将冲刷干净，我们必须决定如何处置这个新生命。
texts.en: While cleaning out the radiation in [From.GetName]'s atmosphere and soil, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to call in our xenobiologists. They had found a species that seemed to thrive off the radiation and was now wilting. Even more curious, this species appears to be presapient and on the cusp of achieving sentience. Now, as the final soil scrubbers are approaching, we have to decide what to do with this new life.

texts.zh:
我们刚刚从[From.GetName]的大气和土壤中清除了又一层辐射，为未来的自己铺平了道路。然而，我们警觉的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]不得不介入并暂时隔离了这个世界的某些区域。我们的行动似乎惊扰了一种极其难以捉摸的本土物种，它们在放射性环境中茁壮成长，但由于我们的干预，它们已经开始枯萎。

更令人费解的是，这种物种似乎正处于未开智的阶段，但即将迈向智慧的进化关口。如今，随着[From.GetName]即将完全清除最后的有害环境，我们面临一个重要抉择：如何对待这一新生而独特的生命形式？
texts.en:
We have freed our future selves from another layer of radiation in the atmosphere and soil of [From.GetName]. However, our watchful [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] had to intervene and have temporarily isolated part of this world. We appear to have disturbed an extremely elusive native species that thrives in radioactive environments. Unfortunately, due to our actions, it has begun to wilt.

Even more curiously, this species appears to be presapient: they are on the cusp of achieving independent thought. Now, as [From.GetName] is poised to purge the last of its hazardous environmental legacy, we must decide how to handle this novel form of life.

label.zh: 我们毁掉了它们的栖息地，现在我们应当保护它们。
label.en: We have destroyed their habitat, now we have to preserve them.

label.zh: 为什么不让它们加入我们？
label.en: Why not let them join us?

label.zh: 我们何苦要担忧这些杂草呢。完成环境改造。
label.en: Why are we even bothering with this weed. Finish the terraforming.

texts.zh: 在花费数年调整这些我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]上发现的辐射合成植物，并且使其适应环境之后，我们现在可以将他们纳入我们的社会了。尽管这个物种还出人意料地年轻，但是他们看上去非常擅长收集能量。
texts.en: Having spent years acclimating and adjusting the radiotrophic plants found on [FromFromFrom.GetName], we now are ready to allow them into our society. While an incredibly young species, they seem to excel in harvesting energy.

texts.zh: 恢复一个死寂星球是一项艰苦的工作，而且十分单调重复：隔绝一块区域，清理所有的卵石，替换土地，净化任何残留的水源，添加新的动物。随着[From.GetName]的环境改造进程逐渐扫尾，我们的[Root.GetTerraformerPlural]发现了一个规模可观的地下金属容器，根据其防御工事，我们假定这是一个武器库。
texts.en: Restoring a Tomb World is always hard work and often very repetitive: section off an area, clear out any rubble, replace the soil, purify any remaining water, and add new fauna. As the terraforming process on [From.GetName] was winding to a close, our [Root.GetTerraformerPlural] discovered a sizeable underground metal container, and based on its fortifications, it is assumed that this is a weapons cache.

texts.zh: 这些可以在极高辐射强度的星球下存活并繁衍兴盛的植物可以作为我们帝国绝佳的补充。不过在此之前，我们需要提升他们的心智并在数月内教会它们我们数千年来的进展。
texts.en: These plants that can live and thrive on worlds with more radiation than atmosphere could be an excellent addition to our empire. But before then, we will need to enhance their minds and teach them thousands of years of progress in a few months.
